subject: [PATCH v2 2/4] mm: allow shared folios to be promoted to a fast tier

2026-09-11.patch_summary: This patch allows shared copy-on-write folios and executable file folios mapped by multiple processes to be promoted from a slow memory tier to a fast one, while maintaining existing restrictions for ordinary placement. This change is intended to improve the performance of memory tiering systems by allowing hot folios on slow tiers to be moved to faster storage. The patch modifies two kernel files, mm/mempolicy.c and mm/migrate.c, to relax the checks that previously blocked such promotions. The changes are based on a previous patch (c574bbe91703) that optimized page placement for memory tiering systems.
